positive_controls.argument: Reproducible candidate state and its bounded verification results provide inspectable realized behavior for the named feasibility question, including defects that can stop a premature commitment.
Reproducible packaging and relevant verification identify a stable article for qualification and make evidence-to-candidate correspondence possible even while exposure is withheld.
Candidate-bound verification and an explicit separation of packaging from exposure supply evidence about those controls while allowing a technically built candidate to remain withheld.
Visible reproducible technical readiness supplies one concrete input to cutover and permits the candidate to be staged while missing people, procedure or support conditions are resolved.
Identified reproducible artifacts and explicit exposure control preserve a concrete deployable fallback or roll-forward candidate that recovery planning can test.
Maintained build and packaging identity make an actual patch or replacement version reconstructable and stageable, reducing dependence on an undocumented one-off release.

The distinction between candidate readiness and authorized exposure identifies a cheaper preparation step and a separate consequence-bearing decision, preventing one cadence from imposing identical controls on both.

An identified reproducible maintenance candidate can demonstrate a bounded late repair whose preparation effort does not increase merely because the release is late, separating release transaction cost from other losses.

source.criterion: Keep release readiness visible while separating integration, deployment and authorized exposure decisions.

receiver.bearer: The universal exponential relationship between later change and cost
receiver.criterion: Reject a universal exponential law; distinguish development repair effort from propagation, unwinding commitments and failure/recovery loss.

guard: An actual artifact, state, configuration, population, time horizon and receiving decision are identified as specified in the literal common-object field.
The exact native source mechanism contributes the named evidence, constraint, capability or interpretation to that receiving use. Generic possible co-use is insufficient.
Edit effort, propagation, commitment unwinding and failure/recovery losses remain separate; a partial reduction is material without establishing complete reversibility.
Authority, representative evidence, hidden state, shared failure domains, response capability and binding constraints remain separate premises.
Unknown correspondence remains unknown; a low-consequence cheap path and an adequate existing mechanism remain eligible.
member_to_premise_evidence.source_contribution: An identified reproducible maintenance candidate can demonstrate a bounded late repair whose preparation effort does not increase merely because the release is late, separating release transaction cost from other losses.
member_to_premise_evidence.receiving_consequence: An identified reproducible maintenance candidate can demonstrate a bounded late repair whose preparation effort does not increase merely because the release is late, separating release transaction cost from other losses.
premises_supplied: An identified reproducible maintenance candidate can demonstrate a bounded late repair whose preparation effort does not increase merely because the release is late, separating release transaction cost from other losses.
premises_remaining: Reject a universal exponential law; distinguish development repair effort from propagation, unwinding commitments and failure/recovery loss.
All receiver-native scope, authority and evidence conditions beyond the literal partial contribution; actual net benefit remains to be established.
member_to_premise_evidence.counterexample: A cheap build does not imply cheap data migration, contract unwinding or recovery from a harmful deployed defect.
member_to_premise_evidence.counter_control: A cheap build does not imply cheap data migration, contract unwinding or recovery from a harmful deployed defect.
member_to_premise_evidence.nontrigger: The specified actual shared object, mechanism or receiving use is known absent. If it is merely unestablished, retain that uncertainty rather than declaring no relationship.
specific_cost_and_alternative: Account for structural work, requalification, telemetry, isolation, rehearsal, backup, coexistence, maintenance and delayed beneficial change; do not count the same shared capacity twice.
Compare existing verified seams, a manual controlled release, targeted checks, simulation, a qualified pilot, roll-forward repair, replacement and deliberate retirement as applicable.
A frozen stage, infrequent release or no change may be adequate; no universal deployment cadence or additional approver follows.
Binding constraints and explicitly nontradeable harms limit the choice set independently of ordinary service-budget economics.
member_to_premise_evidence.reentry: Reopen the affected literal direction if configuration, state, population, timing, coupling, exposure, recovery evidence, source version, receiving use, support horizon or authority changes. A failed guard does not establish a global negative; reverse and transitive claims require separate inquiry.
